name: Shionoe (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shionoe town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised three-armed device.
history: Flag of the former town of Shionoe in Kagawa Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-09-26. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1963.

features.role: Shionoe town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised three-armed device
